notes.title: Fix for bug with stairs
notes.content: There was a bug with the stairs where you could get completely stuck. Should be fixed now!

notes.title: Deemphasize mouse controls
notes.content:
* Moves mouse controls to the accessibility menu. Can still switch dynamically between keyboard and controller.
* Fixes for some minor bugs with animation transition, "indoor" music, and interacting with the stump
* Attempt at fixing Steam Deck compatibility issue

notes.title: Mac OS Pain
notes.content: This patch was an attempt to fix a launch issue affecting Big Sur and older versions of MacOS; unfortunately it did not work - sorry :(
